Write the derived values out as an editable YAML config

Source: R/config-session.R
write_config.Rd

Every threshold carries its source and a review flag. The config is an OVERRIDE mechanism: the script derives everything at runtime and runs without it. Values under derived_from_batch document what THIS batch produced – editing them changes future runs; deleting the file changes nothing.

Usage

write_config(
  path,
  derived,
  cofactors,
  spec = default_population_spec(),
  blocks = default_functional_blocks(),
  colmap = default_column_map(),
  valmap = default_value_map(),
  colors = default_colors()
)

Arguments

path

File path.

derived

The derived.

cofactors

The cofactors.

spec

Population specification mapping population name to marker directions. See default_population_spec(). Default default_population_spec().

blocks

Functional-marker blocks. See default_functional_blocks(). Default default_functional_blocks().

colmap

The colmap. Default default_column_map().

valmap

The valmap. Default default_value_map().

colors

Named list of colours; defaults to the package palette. See fcs_colors(). Default default_colors().
